recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to the extension definition, display name, title, or usage context should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack unless a specific current core reference becomes stale.
issue_request: FHIR-12974 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking that the Patient birthPlace extension be renamed from http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace to a patient-prefixed extension URL consistent with other Patient standard extensions.
initial_application: Git history shows explicit application in e2e7e918b0d131eb5f933729c2eca6935a2392af, 'GF#12974 move patient-birthPlace extension', which moved the extension into the Patient extension spreadsheet and noted that it came from a general non-patient-prefixed extension. Later R4/R4B history and R4B-era source carried patient-birthPlace.
additional_context: Current FHIR core no longer owns the extension definition because dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed R5 extension definitions from core. The FHIR Extension Pack currently defines input/definitions/Patient/StructureDefinition-patient-birthPlace.xml with id patient-birthPlace, URL http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace, and matching fixedUri. Current core references outside historical release material also use patient-birthPlace. Later FHIR-45141 is AU Core out-of-scope feedback that points naming concerns to the Extension Pack rather than creating a core source change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the seed rename is already represented in current core references and in the authoritative Extension Pack definition.

related_jiras.note: Later AU Core ballot feedback raised a related birthPlace naming concern but was resolved as out of scope for AU Core and directed to the FHIR Extension Pack.
US Core feedback raised broader reuse of human-demographic extensions, but the resolution changed US Core Race/Ethnicity contexts and did not reverse the patient-birthPlace canonical.
